thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Kinetic energy accumulation under constant power
thirteen_wpe_families.formula: K_f = 0.5 * m * v_0^2 + P * t; v_f = sqrt(2 * K_f / m)

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Center of mass work for uniform hanging chain/rope
Force-distance integral and conservative force gradient
Vertical circular motion energy conservation and taut string condition
thirteen_wpe_families.formula: v_top^2 = v_bot^2 - 4 * g * r; T_top = m * (v_top^2 / r - g) >= 0

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Piecewise potential well accessible domain indices and barrier crossing
thirteen_wpe_families.formula: crossing = E >= barrier; accessible = {i : U_i <= E}

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Spring release across rough horizontal plane and projectile trajectory

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Piecewise central force potential integration and orbital kinetic energy
Vector dot product power from force and velocity vectors

thirteen_wpe_families.formula: F = dm/dt * v; P_kinetic = 0.5 * dm/dt * v^2; P_motor = dm/dt * v^2

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Coefficient of restitution velocity drop and mechanical energy loss
thirteen_wpe_families.formula: v_rebound = e * v_impact; Delta_E = 0.5 * m * (v_impact^2 - v_rebound^2)

thirteen_wpe_families.physics_domain: Fixed-force vs fixed-extension spring energy comparison
